title: Avoid stale opening-root selection after a same-claim rename followed by another claim name
outcome: A same-claim root change followed by a deferred other-claim selection does not force the original turn's closing capture onto a stale root.
acceptance: A behavior test opens A on R1, renames A to R2, then names B and closes A; the report follows the agreed root semantics without a spurious scope-changed failure, while unrelated root changes retain their authority fences.
